moments.action: Night drive through the city, cut back and forth between the long-haired passenger and the young American at the wheel. The passenger talks, eyes half-closed; by the last shot the American has stopped answering and only stares ahead.

The talk keeps going in tighter close-ups, the passenger turning to face the driver. The camera finally pulls back to a two-shot inside the cabin, the American's hand on the wheel as he glances across at him.

A blue car streaks past and the orange car takes off after it. The passenger says something through the side window, the driver breaks into a grin, the tachometer swings into the red and his hand clamps the wheel.

An empty night street, then the orange car blurs through frame and runs away up the road between office towers. Inside, the driver is laughing open-mouthed, settling into a grin as the POV over the wheel opens onto the elevated expressway.

A white police car with a helmeted officer slides into view; a dash readout reads 197 KM/H. The rear-view mirror catches it tucked in behind them, and the driver's grin drops as he twists to look back.

The passenger stays calm in profile and talks the driver through it. The American argues back across the cabin, then gives in laughing; the last shot has both of them smiling at each other instead of at the road.
A boot stamps the accelerator to the floor, and a high wide shot shows the orange car pulling away down the lit expressway, leaving the white car trailing behind on the far lane.

Cut to a steaming brick garage where people stand around parked tuner cars. The orange car's door swings open and the long-haired man climbs out, walks around the black car in front of it and heads into the crowd.

A held take follows him from behind as he greets a grinning man and a woman in a white fur coat, then moves on into a warm lantern-lit room to talk with someone there, the American trailing a step behind him.
